name: Kuratani Takako
source:
The only senior who watches over Noa with kindness

She is a second-year student who belongs to the Sakurai Academy girls' track and field club's long-distance team, and Noda's only senior. She is very fond of Noda, who is bright, straightforward, and does things at her own pace. Although she can be strict as a senior in the club, she never pressures Noda and tries to have discussions with him. Currently, she is thinking of taking Noda to a tournament. She seems to know the reason why she doesn't want to participate in the tournament. As can be seen from her relationship with Noda, she has a strong sense of responsibility and a kind personality that is considerate of others, but because she is extremely shy, she often gives off a cold impression to people she meets for the first time. However, once the barrier between them is gone, she is a reliable girl who is considerate of others' positions.
